static_traits.name: 林楠
static_traits.family_status: No immediate family members, living alone
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系因害怕失败与回避活动而受到影响；有两位要好的朋友但not yet与其讨论失败与失望的感受
static_traits.medical_history: without既往心理咨询或治疗史，No major physical illness；既往not yet出现类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能描述情绪与体验并配合记录自动化思维；逻辑较为连贯但倾向Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking；对改变持谨慎与怀疑态度但愿意尝试

basic_info.main_problem: 最近一场桌球比赛失利后，觉得自己not该再玩，产生失败与失望感并逐渐升级，开始回避打桌球及其他活动、疏远朋友，害怕失败；此类感受在面对挫折时都会出现。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望识do not并改变对挫折的灾难化反应与非黑即白信念，挑战负性信念，恢复对活动的享受。

core_beliefs: 我的自我价值取决于胜负与表现

special_situations.event: 最近的桌球比赛中失利
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能赢，就说明我not行、not该再玩
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避再次打桌球以避免失败与尴尬

special_situations.event: 考虑是否再次尝试打桌球
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能确保成功，再次尝试只会证明我not行并让我很丢脸
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免任何not确定能成功的活动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会再输，这会证明我not行，而且很尴尬

special_situations.event: 朋友邀请或社交活动场合
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在朋友面前表现not佳，他们会看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与朋友见面和参与活动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible，最好do not去

special_situations.event: 工作Increased stress、not yet达到自设高标准
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到自己的高期待，就等于个人失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces engagement and enthusiasm; avoids challenges to reduce the risk of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我本来应该做得更好，not做到就是失败

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过Good表现与胜利来获得自我价值感与认可
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure triggering shame and being devalued and judged by others
defense_goal: Avoiding failure and shame by avoiding attempts and maintaining high control standards, protecting self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: 易被失败定义的“not够好的人”
object_relations.object_representation: Others/audiences who may judge and belittle oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to try activities with a possible risk of failure, or encouraged in counseling to challenge negative beliefs and conduct behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If she tries she will fail and be humiliated, so avoidance is a safer choice (transference: seeing others as potential judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以委婉、谨慎的语气强调“安全”“not把握”，提出诸多理由解释not尝试或暂缓，减少明确承诺。

manifestations: 因害怕失败而回避活动与朋友
not yet与亲密朋友讨论失败与失望的感受
以“必须/应该”式高期待约束自己
在not确定能成功时选择not尝试以求“安全”

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: use“我应该做得更好”的自我要求
以胜负与完美标准定义自我价值

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse they originally wanted to act outwardly, turns to act on themselves, and converts the energy inward, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 明知活动能带来快乐却选择not参加，将能量转为Self-doubt与自我批评
避免尝试以减少潜在失败带来的羞耻

positive_force: 意识到灾难化思维并主动求助咨询
愿意尝试记录并观察自动化思维
工作表现基本not yet受影响，仍有稳定的职业功能
Has two friends to talk with (potential support resources)
negative_force: 灾难化与非黑即白认知模式显著
将自我价值与胜负/表现强绑定
Intense shame about failure and anticipatory worry lead to avoidance
Social withdrawal与活动回避，热情下降

target_behavior.behavior: 在面对可能失败的活动和社交时进行回避（包括not再打桌球、减少与朋友互动）
antecedent: 想到可能会失败或表现not佳
工作Increased stress、not yet达自设高标准
回忆最近桌球比赛失利
target_behavior.core_reason: Tying self-worth to winning and losing, catastrophizing predictions about failure accompanied by feelings of shame
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失败与尴尬，短期保护自尊与减少Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 兴趣与热情下降、社交关系受损、Increased self-doubt、Reduced enjoyment of life

target_behavior.behavior: 在挫折后出现极端化言语与认知表达（如“我永远not再玩桌球”）并伴随Anxiety
antecedent: 经历失败或not yet达期望
面对not确定能成功的任务
target_behavior.core_reason: 非黑即白思维与灾难化倾向，高期待trigger的Self-denial
target_behavior.function: 通过极端化结论来获得控制感、避免再次尝试带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 问题被固化、减少练习与改进机会，加重失望与Withdrawal
